chunks: "God has begotten (children)?" They are liars indeed!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God having children?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia theological discourse to refute the Christian doctrine of divine sonship, underscores the absolute transcendence (Tanzih) of Allah, distinguishing Him from created beings who are subject to generation and decay. It serves as a concise rebuttal to those who project human attributes onto the Divine, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid by negating any form of physical or spiritual progeny. The phrase 'indeed they are liars' highlights the epistemological error of attributing limited human experiences to the Infinite.
